i booked a consultation at jryn clinic thinking itd be pretty straightforward you know how a lot of factory style skin clinics work you go in and say what you want they dont argue you pay and you get it done thats what i expected but the doctor actually stopped me and told me to slow down she said that even though my face might look like it has some thickness my skin itself is actually quite thin which makes me more prone to cheek hollowing and volume loss because of that doing ulthermage could actually increase the risk of side effects rather than help hmm that was weird because ive never been told i have thin skin so hearing that made me rethink everything that actually made me dig into it more on my own so i figured id share in case it helps anyone else ultherapy and thermage are constantly marketed together like theyre this perfect combo so i asked about doing both but she was very clearly not a fan of stacking them in my case she said it can work well for people who have thicker skin or more facial fat but if youre already low on volume or have thin skin youre much more likely to run into problems like cheek dents prolonged swelling or even burns even worse if side effects happen recovery can take a long time and theres no guarantee your face will fully return to how it was before i still asked if i could at least do ultherapy under sedation since im really bad at handling pain she said its possible but also doesnt recommend it even under sedation my body can still move without you realizing it and since i cant give feedback during the procedure the risk of burns goes up some doctors say they can tell when its too painful based on movement but she said thats very subjective and not something she thinks is safe to rely on from a patient safety standpoint she also mentioned that sedation itself comes with risks like breathing issues or oxygen level problems and that kind of stuck with me because this is still an elective cosmetic procedure another thing she pointed out was that people who say ulthermage didnt do anything for them usually have one thing in common their skin foundation is already pretty weak most lifting treatments work by creating controlled micro damage to trigger collagen production but if your skin quality isnt great to begin with recovery is slower pain feels worse and results are underwhelming after actually
